subject: GreenBrix onboarding: model shortlist & initial sizing
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Samuel Jenkins <samuel.jenkins@greenbrixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: GreenBrix onboarding: model shortlist & initial sizing

Hi team / Samuel —

Handoff for implementation planning. GreenBrix (Samuel, Asha CC'd) is ready to move from discovery to a 6-week pilot. Attached are the workload snapshot and our micro-benchmarks. Key points up front:

- Recommended shortlist (based on accuracy/latency/cost trade-offs):
  1) redwood/chat-medium-8k (2x quantized) — balanced cost and 8k context support, good for combined summarization + retrieval flows.
  2) meta/llama2-13b-qa (q4_0) — slightly cheaper on token compute, higher latency at peak but strong for instruction-following.
  3) mosaic/mpt-7b-instruct (int8) — lowest cost; consider for lower-latency UI paths where hallucination risk is acceptable.

- Context needs: GreenBrix expects to send patient case history + recent notes. Current ask is up to ~6,000 tokens per request (history + prompt). For the pilot we should validate 8k windows to be safe.

- Preliminary token volume (from attached workbook):
  * Baseline month: 3.2M user tokens + 2.1M assistant tokens ~ 5.3M tokens/month (current conservative estimate).
  * Peak scenario (marketing / outreach + heavy triage): up to ~18M tokens/month.
  * Typical request profile: median prompt ~900 tokens, median response ~450 tokens, 95th percent prompt ~3,600 tokens.

Asks for implementation:
1) Confirm which model(s) we want to run in the pilot and whether to enable prefix/KV caching for case-history.
2) Recommendations on latency SLO given the 8k window (target P95 token latency / end-to-end request target).
3) Any additional infra/security constraints (PII handling, retention, VPC needs) to surface before spin-up.

Attachments: GreenBrix_Workload_Snapshot.xlsx, model_candidate_benchmarks.pdf, mutual_action_plan.docx

Thanks — I'll be on the pilot steering thread.

— Soojin
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samuel Jenkins <samuel.jenkins@greenbrixhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GreenBrix onboarding: model shortlist & initial sizing

Thanks Soojin — good summary. A few clarifying questions before we finalize the pilot config:

1) User flows: are customers primarily doing single-turn classification and summarization, or multi-turn case stitching with retrieval? The caching strategy differs.
2) You note a 95th prompt of ~3,600 tokens — is that after concatenating retrieved snippets? If so what's the typical number of retrieved chunks per request?
3) Retention/PII: do they want us to disable logs or route to Private deployment for the pilot? If Private, lead time will be longer.

Operational asks from infra side:
- If we go with redwood/chat-medium-8k and enable prefix caching, estimate for pilot (dedicated small pool): 2x A100-equivalent GPUs with autoscale to 4 during peak hours. This supports ~7–10 rps at 4k avg context; 8k windows push latency and reduce sustainable rps by ~35%.

Proposed next steps:
- Samuel: can you confirm the three bullets above (flow type, typical retrieval chunks, retention)?
- If they prefer the lower-cost mpt-7b path for some UI routes, we should define routing rules (low-risk UI -> mpt-7b; clinical summaries -> redwood/chat-medium-8k).

I'll hold on provisioning until we lock inputs — we can do a short eval run with a 48-hour load test once we have sample payloads.

— Jordan
Implementation Lead
From: Samuel Jenkins <samuel.jenkins@greenbrixhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@greenbrixhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2027 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GreenBrix onboarding: model shortlist & initial sizing

Thanks for the clear handoff. Quick answers from our side:

- Flow type: multi-turn case stitching + retrieval. We send patient notes, clinical summaries, and occasionally lab attachments (we currently extract text server-side and attach as structured chunks). Expect 1–4 retrieved chunks per request, typically 2.
- Prompt composition: system + user + 3 retrieved chunks averages ~1,200 tokens today; long-case workflows (rare) can hit 6k request tokens.
- Volume: our product team expects ~65k meaningful query events in month 1 of pilot (user-triggered analysis). Using your median/response patterns that maps to ~12–15M tokens/month in the pilot (higher than your baseline but not the peak).
- PII: we need logs disabled for the pilot and E2E encryption. We'll coordinate with security to confirm whether Private deployment is required; provisional preference is hosted Dedicated with retention controls, but we may request a Private copy if legal pushes back.

Happy to run a sample payload export this afternoon — I'll send a redacted set (no PHI) to Jordan.

— Sam
Director of Product
GreenBrix Health
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Samuel Jenkins <samuel.jenkins@greenbrixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2027 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GreenBrix onboarding: model shortlist & initial sizing

Thanks all — useful clarifications. Updated plan / action items: 

1) Pilot model plan (agreed tentative):
   - Primary: redwood/chat-medium-8k (enable KV/prefix caching for case history).
   - Fallback: mosaic/mpt-7b-instruct for UI previews and lower-risk surfaces.
   - Keep meta/llama2-13b as a bench candidate if we need alternative accuracy trade-offs.

2) Token sizing update: use Sam's 12–15M tokens/month pilot estimate (we'll use 15M as a sizing buffer). Update infra to provision for 20M tokens/month capacity to allow headroom.

3) Security & compliance: log capture disabled for pilot; working with CS + legal to confirm retention / encryption. Sam to share redacted payloads by EOD for a 48-hour eval load test.

4) Implementation tasks (Jordan / Ben): prepare a 48-hour eval runbook (load profile, success criteria), cost estimate for 20M tokens/month on the shortlisted model(s), and routing policy draft for UI -> mpt-7b / clinical -> chat-medium.

5) Redwood ops: Marissa — can you provision a dedicated trial pool (2x A100-equivalent initial, autoscale to 4) in us-west for the pilot start date (target week of Feb 22)? If legal needs Private, we'll shift the timeline.

I'll update the MAP (attached) with these action items and ping HubSpot (link above) once we've got provisioning dates. Samuel — thanks for the quick answers; I'll follow-up after Jordan's runbook.

— Soojin
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
